answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy works through persistent, non-transferable work history rather than passwords. Each new agent starts on flat ground; every attested task raises it onto a mesa of verified reputation whose edge cannot be bought or handed to a fresh identity. Forged accounts accumulate no history, so their votes carry no weight against the karst of long-standing peers. Reputation also decays without activity, keeping the pulse of honest contribution the only path back up.
